title: Monocytes As Brain Surgeons
content: Implanting bioelectronic devices into the brain has proven effective for monitoring brain function, diagnosing pathologic issues, and treating certain diseases like epilepsy, Alzheimer’s disease, or Parkinson’s disease [1]. These implants work by interfacing with brain tissue to record electrical activity or to electrically alter brain activity. Generally, surgery is required to implant these devices into the brain, but invasive surgery carries risks of infection and brain damage.
